original_test_intent: Verify the dedicated 32-bit Type 7 Maximum Cache Size 2 field is present on applicable structures, encodes the approved maximum capacity and granularity, is selected consistently by the legacy Maximum Cache Size field and persists after reboot.
original_method: Capture raw Type 7 bytes plus decoded output, bounds-check formatted length, extract the extended maximum-size value and granularity by defined offset, retain the legacy maximum word, validate selector/effective capacity per cache handle, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves the extended capacity baseline, Type 7 revision/length, granularity and legacy-selector rules, plus reboot plan. Raw field validation is automatable.
required_inputs: Applicable SMBIOS revision and minimum Type 7 formatted length/offset for Maximum Cache Size 2
Expected raw/effective extended maximum capacity per Type 7 handle
Legacy Maximum Cache Size selector relationship and policy for an unselected-but-present field
Validated raw parser plus approved reboot and OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; do not resize, flush or reconfigure caches or firmware.
Do not rely on a literal `Maximum Cache Size 2` display line; preserve raw Type 7 bytes, length and exact 32-bit field.
Bounds-check the read and retain the extended granularity bit/value plus legacy maximum word for selector validation.
Do not substitute Installed Size 2 or OS-visible cache capacity; this case targets maximum supported capacity encoding.
Stop on unsupported length, invalid selector/granularity, per-handle mismatch, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Extract raw Maximum Cache Size 2 per applicable Type 7 record, decode units, validate legacy selector and approved capacity before/after reboot.
Do not alter caches, replace the field with normalized/installed capacity or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve field layout/version, extended maximum values, granularity and selector policy.
Approve reboot/recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The literal label is decoder-dependent and cannot establish raw field presence, formatted-length bounds, granularity or legacy selection.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a validated raw Type 7 parser to capture formatted length, legacy maximum word and Maximum Cache Size 2 UINT32 with granularity; retain dmidecode only as secondary evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The dedicated Maximum Cache Size 2 scope, Type 7 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Decode Maximum Cache Size 2 directly from each sufficiently long Type 7 structure, preserve raw granularity/value, confirm legacy selector use and compare the effective maximum bytes per cache handle before and after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 7 records whose revision/length includes Maximum Cache Size 2.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, Type 7 length, BIOS, CPU/cache topology and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 7 Maximum Cache Size 2 field layout, granularity and legacy selector semantics, approved cache topology and installed parser documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces display-label dependence with direct bounds-checked 32-bit field validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Improves coverage by proving the extended encoding rather than only a normalized effective size.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Extended maximum baseline, granularity and selector rules.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some decoders fold extended values into `Maximum Cache Size`; raw parsing is necessary to keep this dedicated field coverage distinct.

project_override_considerations: A project may declare the field not applicable only from an approved SMBIOS revision/Type 7 length. When present, its raw encoding and selector relationship must be checked independently of the general maximum-size case.
expected_evidence: Approved Type 7 extended-field definition, per-handle maximum values, granularity/selector policy and parser versions
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 7 bytes with handle/level, formatted length, legacy word and extended UINT32/granularity
Bounds, selector and effective-byte comparison results
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot raw comparison
Engineer verdict or revision/length-based not-applicable determination
